mb_cam — MachineBench CAM helper library (runs INSIDE Fusion).

This is the script-side companion to the system prompt's CAM_RECIPE: it turns the
recipe's *prose* plumbing into callable functions so a model spends its rounds on
CAM DECISIONS, not on reverse-engineering the adsk.cam API or hand-writing the
gnarly idioms. It is loaded into every `fusion_mcp_execute` script as `mb`
(the harness prepends the import), and is given to EVERY model equally.

DESIGN CONTRACT — mechanics provided, decisions withheld (mirror of prompts.py):
  • Helpers encapsulate ONLY mechanics: product fetch + Manufacturing activate,
    models-as-list, attach-tool-before-add, geometry selection + commit, the
    generate-and-wait dance, expression/unit quoting, derived-param noise.
  • Every graded CAM DECISION is a REQUIRED argument with NO default — tool,
    strategy, geometry, stepover, stepdown, feeds/speeds, WCS origin, stock
    allowance, heights. The library never picks these; the model must.
  • Units are MILLIMETRES at the boundary (Fusion internal is cm); helpers convert
    so the model never juggles cm. Angles stay degrees at the boundary.

IDENTIFIERS: Fusion DOCUMENT state persists across execute() calls but Python
variables do NOT, so helpers take/return STABLE identifiers (setup name, op name,
document-tool index, face index) — the model re-fetches by id each script and
builds CAM incrementally. Inspection helpers return compact JSON-able dicts.

This module imports adsk.* at top and is only ever imported inside Fusion."

def run(_context):
    # Rough: enable multiple depths, 10mm stepdown, keep 0.5mm stock
    mb.set_params('Setup1', '2D Adaptive1', {
        'doMultipleDepths': 'true',
        'maximumStepdown': '10mm',
        'stockToLeave': '0.5mm',
        'verticalStockToLeave': '0.2mm',
    })
    # Finish pocket walls+floor with 3/8" (pocket corner R=5mm > tool R=4.76mm)
    r = mb.add_operation('Setup1', strategy='pocket2d', tool=2,
                         geometry={'faces':[5], 'type':'pocket'})
    print(r['operation'])
    mb.set_params('Setup1', r['operation'], {
        'stockToLeave': '0mm',
        'doMultipleDepths': 'false',
    })
    # Outside profile finish: 2D contour around part perimeter, full depth via multiple depths
    r2 = mb.add_operation('Setup1', strategy='contour2d', tool=3,
                          geometry={'faces':[9,10,11,12], 'type':'contour'})
    print(r2['operation'])
    mb.set_params('Setup1', r2['operation'], {
        'doMultipleDepths': 'true',
        'maximumStepdown': '12mm',
        'stockToLeave': '0mm',
    })
    print('ok')
